info.title: bsm
info.description: Badger SQL Migrate: free, cross-platform, hash-certified database migrations for SQL Server and Azure SQL, with real up and down, named changes, environments, Entra ID and Always Encrypted.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Badger SQL Migrate - hash-certified, plan-based database migrations with real up and down.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --project
options.description: Project directory containing bsm.yaml and bsm.plan. [default: .]

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment from bsm.yaml (or BSM_ENV; default: defaultEnvironment).

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Override the environment's connection string.

options.name: --claim-environment
options.description: Allow a database recorded under another environment name (e.g. restored from prod) and record this one. [default: False]

options.name: --var
options.description: Script variable, name=value. Repeatable.

options.name: --json
options.description: Machine-readable output on stdout. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show server messages and details. [default: False]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI colors (also honors NO_COLOR). [default: False]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create bsm.yaml, bsm.plan and folders in the project directory.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Database provider. [default: sqlserver]

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a change: creates changes/<name>/ scripts and appends it to bsm.plan.

options.name: --requires
options.description: Changes this one depends on.

options.name: --note
options.description: Note stored in the plan.

options.name: --notx
options.description: Run outside a transaction. [default: False]

options.name: --irreversible
options.description: No revert script. [default: False]

commands.name: tag
commands.description: Tag the last change in the plan (use as @name in --to).

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Plan file commands.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate the plan, folders and scripts (no database needed). Use in CI and pre-commit hooks.

commands.name: show
commands.description: List planned changes with script hashes and chain ids (no database needed).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Compare the plan with the database.

options.name: --exit-code
options.description: Exit with 3 when the database is not up to date. [default: False]

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Provision environment resources, then deploy pending changes and repeatables.

options.name: --to
options.description: Deploy up to and including this change or @tag.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would run without changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --script
options.description: Write a reviewable SQL script of pending changes to this file instead of deploying.

options.name: --ordering
options.description: Override the environment's ordering policy (dependency|strict).

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask for confirmation (required in non-interactive runs against protected environments). [default: False]

commands.name: revert
commands.description: Revert changes using the revert scripts stored in the database at deploy time.

options.name: --to
options.description: Revert everything deployed after this change or @tag.

options.name: --last
options.description: Revert the last N deployed changes.

options.name: --all
options.description: Revert every deployed change. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would run without changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask for confirmation (required in non-interactive runs against protected environments). [default: False]

options.name: --allow-variable-drift
options.description: Revert even if the revert script renders differently than at deploy time. [default: False]

commands.name: rebase
commands.description: Revert to a change, then redeploy to head (handy while iterating on a change).

options.name: --to
options.description: Revert to this change or @tag, then deploy to the plan head.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask for confirmation (required in non-interactive runs against protected environments). [default: False]

options.name: --allow-variable-drift
options.description: Revert even if the revert script renders differently than at deploy time. [default: False]

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Check deployed hashes against the working copy, run verify scripts, and detect schema drift.

commands.name: log
commands.description: Show the deploy/revert/failure history recorded in the database.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Number of events. [default: 50]

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Adopt an existing database: record changes as applied without running them.

options.name: --to
options.description: Mark changes up to this one as already applied.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask for confirmation (required in non-interactive runs against protected environments). [default: False]

commands.name: vars
commands.description: List built-in and user variables for an environment, resolved ({name} and $(name) in scripts).

commands.name: render
commands.description: Print a script exactly as it would be sent to the database for an environment.

options.name: --kind
options.description: deploy | revert | verify (changes only). [default: deploy]

commands.name: env
commands.description: Environment commands.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List environments (templates start with '_').

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the fully resolved environment (extends merged, secrets masked).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Compare per-environment resources (e.g. Always Encrypted keys) with the database.

commands.name: provision
commands.description: Create or rotate per-environment resources without deploying changes.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would run without changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-destructive
options.description: Also apply destructive steps, e.g. drop a column encryption key value protected by a retired master key. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask for confirmation (required in non-interactive runs against protected environments). [default: False]

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Entra ID sign-in commands.

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Forget saved interactive/device-code sign-ins so the next run signs in again.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check configuration, sign-in and connectivity for an environment and explain problems.
